title: fix: resolve Check Links and Validate Dependencies CI failures
body:
Two CI workflows failing on `main`: Check Links (regex parse error) and Validate Dependencies (minimatch ReDoS audit failure).

### Check Links — invalid regex in `.lycheeignore`

`.lycheeignore` contained glob patterns (`**/meta.json`) but lychee parses these as regex, causing:
```
regex parse error:
    **/meta.json
    ^
error: repetition operator missing expression
```

- Removed glob-style file path patterns from `.lycheeignore` (these are file paths, not URLs — wrong file)
- Moved exclusions to `lychee.toml` `exclude_path` with proper regex:
  ```toml
  exclude_path = [
      "\\.lycheeignore$",
      "(^|.*/)meta\\.json$",
      "(^|.*/)meta\\.cn\\.json$"
  ]
  ```
- Removed now-redundant `--exclude-path` CLI args from workflow

### Validate Dependencies — minimatch ReDoS (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26)

`pnpm audit --audit-level=high` failing on 3 high-severity `minimatch` vulns in transitive deps (`@oclif/core`, `@vscode/vsce`).

- Added pnpm override to force patched version:
  ```json
  "pnpm": {
    "overrides": {
      "minimatch@<10.2.1": "10.2.1"
    }
  }
  ```

### ROADMAP

Updated stale codebase metrics (200 schema files, 1,600+ exports, 6,507 tests).
